'''''Leilana's Dagger''''' was a modified [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] piloted by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jayn]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ''Dagger'' was named after Jayn's long-lost love. It was destroyed on [[Iope]], the third moon of [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]], by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RF4" />
